drivers.explanation: Active patients fell 35.4% in 90 days (1,011 to 653) and sit at only 54.4% of forecast, so the program is well below the enrollment the manufacturer expects, even allowing for seasonality.
Brand-team engagement with the portal has halved and is down to one weekly user, which weakens the signal that the manufacturer is watching and invested in the program.
Mitigating factors: no sev1 tickets, no open escalation, NPS of 8, zero days overdue on invoices, an active champion, and first fills in a median of 2.5 days with 81.1% refill adherence.

tool_input.next_step: Get the brand team's forecast-by-month for the spring ramp in writing from Victor this week, and schedule an exec check-in before renewal to confirm the seasonal dip is expected and to re-engage the portal users.
